title: WF03 ADP-04b coverage blocker: explicit default-tenant OIDC boundary tests missing
summary: Resolved ADP04B-COVERAGE-01 and ADP04B-COVERAGE-02 by adding explicit executable coverage for default-tenant OIDC boundary behavior in the ADP-04b integration suite, plus a minimal service helper used to assert normalization deterministically.

root_cause.details: The implementation already enforced default-tenant OIDC realm rules, but the integration suite did not include explicit tests for non-bpm-default rejection and omitted-realm normalization paths, so TEST-RUNNER could not trace both MUST boundaries to executable passing evidence.

changes: Added TC-ADP-04b-05 to assert IdentityError.DefaultTenantRealmMismatch when OIDC-enabled default tenant receives non-bpm-default realm input.
Added TC-ADP-04b-06 to assert omitted realm normalizes to bpm-default under OIDC-enabled default-tenant flow.
Refactored createTenant realm decision logic into Service.resolveTenantRealmBinding for minimal reusable deterministic assertion coverage.

prevention: When test specs record MUST coverage risks, add explicit executable tests for each risk before Step-04 validation to avoid traceability FAILs.
For boundary behavior embedded in service input normalization, keep a small deterministic helper path that can be directly asserted in tests.
